origin.description: Report that R 4.5 removed the xfig device.

arguments.name: new
arguments.text: Unused path. The device is no longer available.

origin.details: grDevices::xfig was removed in R 4.5.0. withr still calls it, so the installed function raises that removal error.
origin.value: The error from the removed device.
